split_pair_derivation.rationale: One global suit bijection maps AsKh to AsKc and leaves QdQs unchanged; it gives a bijection of the 1,712,304 legal unordered boards and preserves all poker ranks. This is a derivation from the pinned physical count, not a fresh independent enumeration.

trace_scope: Two separate complete 3000-CFR+ prepared solves plus JSON serialization for the weighted three-pair fixture, one per mode. Includes validation/admission/tree/rows/training/production diagnostics/serialization. Input immutable table, independent replay and RSS excluded. Python tracemalloc only; traced timings are excluded from untraced medians.

method.timing: Four cases x three algorithms, 1000 sweeps once and 3000 sweeps three paired repeats. Alternate categorical/mean mode order by repeat. GC before timer, progress outside timer. Complete prepared solve + diagnostics + JSON; preparation/ranking/module import excluded. All raw samples retained unadjusted, including sleep/scheduling outliers.
method.quality: Independent numeric legal tree and exact Fraction own-hand best responses against pinned physical counts. Final NashConv and known-AA-value error plus1e-10padding must be <=0.005 chips. Scalar replay tolerance1e-10. Cross-mode scalar discrepancies <=1e-8 at every checkpoint. Legal actions/ownhands/histories/physicalcounts/prior dictionaries match exactly. Policy probability differences are recorded, not a gate: float summation changes can affect indifferent actions.
method.provenance: Reuses three pinned PR125 independently enumerated physical W/T/L artifacts; fourth split pair uses one recorded global c-h suit bijection. No new physical enumeration, count preparation timing or new cold-call/native speed claim.
method.admission: Both modes admitted for full requested prepared-counts work before any tree/training. Source-inclusive comparison admission/rejection recorded separately. Rank/physical/table/tree/action/iteration caps unchanged. Meanmode retains categoryvalidation/setup plus extra256Pcollapse charge.
method.scope: Finite heads-up preflop-only betting followed by hidden full-deck forced checkdown. No later-street decisions, unrestricted NLHE, rake, antes, multiway or profitability claim.

game_equivalence: Only W/T/L categories within each ordered private pair are integrated. Decisions never reveal category, fold payoffs are sign-independent, showdown payoffs linear in sign, and policy reaches are category-independent. Means are exact Fractions before binary64 conversion. Hidden opponent-hand pairs remain distinct; no per-pair maximization or board revealing. Zero means retain fullprior and ties remain in the denominator. Mathematical game unchanged; float/order equality is measured, not assumed.
